items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: When he was done, he played with Tuxedo. I know.

ctx.x: They used to call him Mr. Chicken Powell. He'd give dances for the color out there in New York. That's right. On Saturday nights. Well, that would be after they'd go to the pay table, long-term, and pay off, you know. Had plenty of money to flash around, and of course the women would be there. And they and them was playing there then. But I wasn't his wife in them days, but I know him. I used to follow up in dances and bands. I had a cousin, Henry Zeno, who used to play. The drummer? With Kid Oliver. That was kin…

When he was done, he played with Tuxedo. I know. That's when he died. He played with Tuxedo. But I, about 32 cents I've been in New York. I ain't never here about a drummer. That's interesting. Yes, that's interesting. Oh, everybody used to talk somewhat about that boy. Father did, too. That's why he's here.
